key_insight: BoT-GRPO replaces uniform token-level credit assignment with length-invariant aggregation of token rewards, enabling faster and better process-reward RL without a critic.
engineering_relevance: It is a drop-in GRPO replacement for reasoning tasks where token-level rewards are available, improving convergence and final accuracy/compile rates with no value network.
method: Collect token-level rewards across all rollouts.
Weight each token reward by the inverse length of its source sequence to form bag-of-tokens statistics.
Compute per-token advantages from these weighted group statistics in a critic-free GRPO update.
evidence_signal: On React code generation and AIME reasoning, BoT-GRPO reached the same or better quality faster than GRPO and recent variants, including up to 1.9× faster to 80% compile rate and up to 8.1% absolute Pass@k gains.
watch_item: The approach depends on having clean, bounded, stable token-level reward signals; noisy or poorly calibrated reward models may reduce the benefit.
paper_title: BoT-GRPO: Efficient Process-Reward RL for Reasoning via Bag-of-Token Aggregation
